entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A Gothic-horror plane of humans preyed on by vampires, werewolves, zombies and ghosts, ruled by the moon and the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel Sorin created to protect humanity, imprisoned in the Helvault, released, driven mad by Nahiri's cryptoliths and unmade by Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker born on Innistrad, whose spark ignited when his grandfather turned him; creator and destroyer of Avacyn.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: An alchemist who created vampirism and Sorin's grandfather, later charmed by Olivia Voldaren.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: The demon who convinced Edgar Markov to experiment with blood.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: An angel trapped and exsanguinated by Edgar Markov and his sons.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker imprisoned in the Helvault by Sorin who later sought vengeance by summoning Emrakul to Innistrad.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison made by Sorin, holding demons and later Avacyn, until it was sundered during the siege of Thraben.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who fought Avacyn and impaled her as she drove him into the Helvault.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The Lunarch who witnessed Avacyn's battle with Griselbrand.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who opened the Helvault to destroy Griselbrand and later led a zombie army against Emrakul.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: The guardian of the Helvault whom Liliana forced to destroy it, later ally of the Gitrog monster.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri's cryptoliths, imprisoned in the Moon by Jace and Tamiyo.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A powerful vampire who allied with Sorin, then took Innistrad's lordship and plunged it into Eternal Night.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Tamiyo, imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Jace, imprisoned Emrakul in the Moon.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An archangel who slew Brisela and was later captured by Olivia Voldaren.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Emrakul's monstrous angel-hybrid spawn, slain by Sigarda.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An angel, sister of Sigarda.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: A fallen archangel, sister of Sigarda, later resurrected.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An angel, sister of Sigarda.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker native to Innistrad who prepared it with Sorin against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who helped Nahiri build the Drownyard Temple and later defended Havengul.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Gisa's brother who helped defeat the Phyrexian force at Havengul.

entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: A mother seen possessed by rage, which fed Avacyn's disgust for humans.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who warned Arlinn about mechanical creatures.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The human religion promising protection from the night, named for Avacyn.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A secret cult of demon worshipers that emerged when Avacyn went missing.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: A force that fought Emrakul at Thraben.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: Warlocks who performed the ritual to end the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that fought at Thraben and intervened against Olivia.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Great wolf creatures that Avacyn made from the Gatstaf werewolves through the cursemute.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A wave of Avacyn's spells that transformed many werewolves and curses.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: The prolonged darkness caused when Emrakul entered the Moon and Olivia disturbed the Dawnhart ritual.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: An ancient artifact Olivia planned to combine with archangel blood to control the angelic flights.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The largest city on Innistrad, site of the siege and the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The Markov family manor, destroyed by Nahiri with lithomancy.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, ravaged by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Innistrad.

events.summary: Edgar Markov, urged by the demon Shilgengar, traps and exsanguinates the angel Marycz and creates the ritual of vampirism.
events.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

events.summary: Edgar forces his grandson Sorin to turn, igniting Sorin's planeswalker spark.
events.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused the boy's planeswalker spark to ignite

events.summary: Sorin forges the angel Avacyn to protect humanity from the vampires, along with the Helvault, and is reviled as a traitor by most vampires.
events.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires and other threats

events.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
events.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

events.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
events.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

events.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
events.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

events.summary: Avacyn transforms the Gatstaf werewolves into wolfir and her cursemute spreads through the plane.
events.quote: she transformed them into the wolfir

events.summary: Freed from the Helvault, Nahiri finds Zendikar ravaged, swears vengeance on Sorin and destroys Markov Manor.
events.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

events.summary: Nahiri's cryptoliths, powered by Innistrad's leylines, summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.
events.quote: These cryptholiths also caused multiple angels

events.summary: Avacyn abandons humanity and becomes the advocate of their genocide, and the cursemute breaks.
events.quote: caused Avacyn to abandon humanity and become the advocate of their genocide

events.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor in ruins and seeks help from Olivia Voldaren.
events.quote: His search brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren

events.summary: Sorin saves Jace and Tamiyo from Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral and, after a battle, unmakes his corrupted creation.
events.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born

events.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad; Sorin is beaten and encased in stone by Nahiri, then abandoned by Olivia, who takes his sword.
events.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

events.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
events.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

events.summary: With Emrakul in the Moon, day and night are unbalanced, werewolves go mad, and frost spreads; Liesa is resurrected.
events.quote: the day and night balance of Innistrad was disturbed

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren disturbs the Dawnhart ritual, begins the Eternal Night, captures Sigarda and plans to marry Edgar Markov to control the bloodlines.
events.quote: Olivia sought to take control over the vampiric bloodlines by marrying the charmed Edgar Markov

events.summary: The Gatewatch and the coven's spirit foil Olivia, who flees; the ritual ends the Eternal Night.
events.quote: caused the Eternal Night to end and the sun to rise again, ending Olivia's scheme

events.summary: Teferi warns Arlinn about mechanical creatures; she and Sorin prepare Innistrad for the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: Teferi warned Arlinn to watch out for "mechanical creatures."

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion strikes; Gisa and Geralf defeat a force at Havengul and Innistrad's zombies prove immune to phyresis.
events.quote: Gisa and Geralf Cecani defeated a powerful Phyrexian invasion force attacking Havengul
